title: Duck Breast Karahi with Ginger and Green Chilli
meta_description: Duck breast karahi: sliced magret de canard cooked fast in a spiced tomato, ginger and green chilli gravy. Halal, no alcohol, ready in 40 minutes.
og_description: French magret de canard meets Lahori karahi technique. Sliced duck breast in a fierce tomato-ginger-chilli gravy. Halal, no alcohol, intensely flavoured and done in 40 minutes.

image_briefs.prompt: Overhead shot of a dark steel karahi pan on a worn wooden surface, filled with glistening sliced duck breast in a deep red-orange tomato masala, scattered with fresh green coriander leaves, thin green chilli slices, and pale ginger matchsticks. Warm side lighting, food photography, editorial style.
image_briefs.alt: Duck breast karahi in a steel karahi pan with tomato masala, ginger and green chilli

image_briefs.prompt: Flat lay of raw ingredients for duck breast karahi: two scored magret de canard breasts skin-side up, four ripe red tomatoes, a knob of fresh ginger, green chillies, and small bowls of cumin seeds, Kashmiri red chilli, coriander powder and turmeric on a linen cloth. Natural daylight.
image_briefs.alt: Ingredients for duck breast karahi including magret de canard, tomatoes, ginger and spices

image_briefs.prompt: Close-up action shot of sliced duck breast being tossed in a bubbling deep red tomato and spice masala in a black carbon steel karahi, steam rising, tongs visible at the edge. Dramatic warm light.
image_briefs.alt: Sliced duck breast being tossed in spiced tomato masala in a karahi pan

image_briefs.prompt: Side-angle shot of duck breast karahi served in a shallow ceramic bowl, slices fanned slightly in the masala, finished with fresh coriander and ginger matchsticks, served alongside a torn naan flatbread on a linen napkin. Warm, low natural light.
image_briefs.alt: Plated duck breast karahi with fresh coriander and naan bread
